```{r task-info}
site_labels <- c("uniandes-co-bogota" = "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota",
                 "uniandes-co-rural" = "pilot_uniandes_co_rural",
                 "mpieva-de" = "pilot_mpieva_de_main",
                 "western-ca" = "pilot_western_ca_main")

core_tasks <- c("matrix", "mrot", "math", "hf", "mg", "sds", "trog", "vocab", "tom")

task_info <- tribble(
  ~item_task , ~task                    , ~task_category,
  "hf"       , "hearts & flowers"       , "executive function",
  "sds"      , "same & different"       , "executive function",
  "mg"       , "memory"                 , "executive function",
  "math"     , "math"                   , "math",
  "matrix"   , "pattern matching"       , "reasoning",
  "mrot"     , "shape rotation"         , "spatial cognition",
  "trog"     , "sentence understanding" , "language",
  "vocab"    , "vocabulary"             , "language",
  "tom"      , "stories"                , "social cognition",
  "pa"       , "language sounds"        , "reading",
  "sre"      , "sentence reading"       , "reading",
  "swr"      , "word reading"           , "reading",
  "mefs"     , "MEFS"                   , "executive function"
) |>
  mutate(task = task |> str_to_title() |> fct_inorder(),
         task_category = task_category |> str_to_title() |> fct_inorder())

# specification for which model to use for each task
task_mods <- tribble(
  ~item_task , ~model_set          , ~itemtype, ~invariance,
  "hf"       , "multigroup_dataset",     "2pl",    "scalar",
  "math"     , "multigroup_dataset",   "rasch",    "scalar",
  "matrix"   , "multigroup_dataset",   "rasch",    "scalar",
  "mg"       , "multigroup_dataset",   "rasch",    "scalar",
  "mrot"     , "multigroup_dataset",     "2pl",    "scalar",
  "trog"     , "multigroup_dataset",   "rasch",    "scalar",
  "sds"      , "multigroup_dataset",   "rasch",    "scalar",
  "vocab"    , "by_language",          "rasch",    "",
  "tom"      , "by_language",          "rasch",    "",
  "pa"       , "by_language",          "rasch",    "",
  "sre"      , "by_language",          "rasch",    "",
  "swr"      , "by_language",          "rasch",    "",
)
```
